### Read in Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(mapview)
library(paletteer)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

```{r}
ag_2015 <- st_read(here("data/Ag_2015.geojson"))

ag_2020 <- st_read(here("data/Ag_2020.geojson"))
```

### Make a Map

```{r}
colors1 <- paletteer_d("palettetown::feraligatr")

mapview(ag_2015, zcol = "cropcatego", col.regions = colors1)
```

Distribution of acreage

```{r}
ggplot(ag_2015, aes(x = acreage)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  theme_minimal() + 
  facet_wrap(~island, scales = "free_y")
```

Questions:

How have things changed between 2015 and 2020?

Has the amount of ag land changed between 2015 and 2020?

```{r}

Sum2015Acre <- sum(ag_2015$acreage) 
Sum2020Acre <- sum(ag_2020$acreage)

Sum2015Acre - Sum2020Acre


```
